g011_mechanism.causal_rule: Final evidence selection enforces max_per_source = max(2, ceil(12/3)) = 4. By the time object.2de0c11066dd97bc1177de1c is reached at final ranked rank 9, four objects from pandaroot_sphinx_2023_08_25_dev have already been selected (ranks 1,2,3,5). The target is therefore excluded with reason source_diversity_cap before the evidence budget is exhausted.
secondary_contributors: No critical/required evidence-group coverage signal is visible to the production selector; selection is rank/source/type based only.
Same-source Docker documentation objects occupy the per-source slots before the native installation critical object.

direct_displacer.promotion_reason: Exact symbol PndDpmGenerator matched in exact channel; symbol-first promotion moves it ahead of object.f516ef98aeecd335607ac0f6.

g016_mechanism.explanation_10_to_11: object.24323bf526f94cd30b58ab41 is reranker rank 14 but is promoted to final ranked rank 3 by symbol_first. This displaces object.f516ef98aeecd335607ac0f6 from reranker rank 10 to final ranked rank 11, causing canonical Recall@10 to miss it. The target is later also excluded from final evidence by source_budget_cap (code cap 3), but the formal top-10 loss is caused by the post-rerank promotion.

shared_root_cause_explanation: Both cases involve deterministic priority/budget mechanisms that are not coverage-aware: g011 is a per-source diversity cap in final evidence selection; g016 is a symbol-first promotion in post-rerank ordering. They are different production stages, but they share the general property that fixed quotas/priorities can displace critical evidence without any representation of required evidence coverage.
